full_judgment: 3. On 29th Bhadra, 1386 B.S. corresponding to 15-9-79 at about 6 A.M. the deceased found 10 maunds of paddy seedling missing and abused and charged the accused for stealing the said paddy. This resulted in a quarrel between them in the courtyard of his house. Being infuriated the accused went into his hut, brought out a dagger and thrust the dagger on the chest of the deceased and fled away. Posh Mullah pulled out the dagger with his right hand and ran after the accused but he fell down on the North West bank of the pond to the south of his house. His second wife Farijan was at that time near the door of the east facing but and his foster daughter Amena was on the courtyard. Both of them saw the assaults and ran behind Poshinullah raising cries. His daughter Rowshanara also immediately came out from the kitchen, saw the accused running away and her father following him and she also ran behind them. They sat down beside the injured Poshinullah as he fall down and began to wail. On hearing their cries Azizur Rahman, Khitish, Abul Hossain, Jasimuddin, Suren and Others came and they narrated the occurrence to them. Abul Hossain the foster son-in-law immediately went and brought a local quack who bandaged the would hut Poshinullah died immediately. Nazemuddin a member of the Union Parishad got the news at his house from a minor boy that the accused had killed Poshinullan. He went immediately to the house of the deceased and found Poshinullah lying dead and his wife, daughter and foster daughter beside the dead body and all of them narrated the occurrence to him. Then he being accompanied by another member Gulzar Hossain went to thana and lodged FIR at 11 A.M. on the same day.
